report:
**Conclusion: Supported.** In the United States, Kyleena (a 19.5 mg levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system) is labeled/approved to prevent pregnancy for **up to five years**. The FDA-hosted prescribing label states that it should be replaced after five years if continued contraception is wanted. This is also consistent with the National Library of Medicine’s DailyMed drug label and Bayer’s official product information.

Sources:  
- https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2023/208224s005lbl.pdf  
- https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=2e07c155-21e1-4781-9633-ce8bddd47080  
- https://labeling.bayerhealthcare.com/html/products/pi/Kyleena_PI.pdf  
- https://www.kyleenahcp.com/
